Name: email
Description: The homeowner or contractor's verified email address once they identify.

Name: user_type
Description: Specifies whether the user is a homeowner looking for service or a contractor/business owner.

Name: atlanta_neighborhood
Description: The homeowner's neighborhood in Atlanta for geo-specific local matching.

Name: $initial_utm_source
Description: The acquisition source captured on the user's very first anonymous app launch.

Name: $initial_utm_medium
Description: The acquisition medium captured on the first anonymous app launch.

Name: $initial_utm_campaign
Description: The marketing campaign name captured on the first anonymous app launch.

Name: $initial_referrer
Description: The referrer URL from which the user downloaded or opened the app.

Name: registry_search_performed
Description: Fires when a homeowner submits or refines a search in the contractor registry.

Name: filter_category
Description: The taxonomy category applied to the search.

Name: filter_tier
Description: The contractor registry tier being filtered.

Name: filter_badges
Description: Array of specific badges selected to refine matches (e.g. Certified, Fast Responder).

Name: results_count
Description: The number of certified pros returned by the filter parameters.

Name: empty_state_rendered
Description: Whether the search resulted in 0 matches, triggering a concierge backup offer.

Name: shmoozer_card_rendered
Description: Fires when a contractor's card is shown to a homeowner in the swiper interface.

Name: pro_business_id
Description: Unique database identifier for the contractor displayed on the swiper card.

Name: pro_business_name
Description: The public brand name of the service business displayed.

Name: pro_tier
Description: The certified tier level of the contractor card.

Name: pro_rating
Description: The average rating score displayed to the swiping homeowner.

Name: card_index
Description: The card's position in the current swiping session deck.

Name: shmoozer_card_swiped
Description: Fires when a homeowner swipes a contractor card left (pass) or right (match interest).

Name: swipe_direction
Description: The direction of the user swipe. Crucial for measuring concierge matchmaking intent.

Name: session_swipe_count
Description: Cumulative swipes done by this user in the current session (identifies power-swipers).

Name: shmoozer_match_triggered
Description: Fires when a 'right' swipe satisfies matching parameters and auto-creates a concierge lead.

Name: concierge_request_id
Description: The backend ID of the concierge ticket generated instantly from the swipe match.

Name: find_my_pro_initiated
Description: Fires when a homeowner launches the 2-step 'Find My Pro' request flow.

Name: find_my_pro_step_1_completed
Description: Fires immediately after Step 1 of the lead flow is submitted (capturing key category/contact details). Allows partial lead follow-up.

Name: requested_category
Description: The service category required by the homeowner.

Name: partial_lead_recorded
Description: Boolean flag indicating this was stored as a high-intent fallback lead in case of abandonment.

Name: find_my_pro_submitted
Description: Fires upon successful completion of Step 2 (full matching lead recorded, pro partner displayed).

Name: matched_pro_id
Description: The ID of the preferred contractor partner shown to the homeowner upon submission.

Name: partner_call_button_clicked
Description: Fires when a homeowner clicks the 'Call' button on a matched partner or profile screen.

Name: call_placement_source
Description: Identifies where the call trigger occurred (e.g., 'find_my_pro_completion', 'profile_view', 'swiper_match_popup').

Name: profile_rendered_gracefully
Description: Fires to verify page loads cleanly even when metadata assets like rating, photos, or deal are absent.

Name: has_photos
Description: Tracks if photos are present on the profile.

Name: has_editorial_story
Description: Tracks if editorial profile text is present.

Name: has_active_deal
Description: Tracks if an active deal/coupon is visible.

Name: external_google_reviews_opened
Description: Fires when a homeowner clicks to read Google reviews from the profile page.

Name: contractor_portal_started
Description: Fires when a business owner clicks 'I run a business' to enter the onboarding funnel.

Name: contractor_qualification_submitted
Description: Fires when a contractor submits their qualification form for certified registry access.

Name: applicant_trade
Description: The trade category selected by the applicant.

Name: instant_qualification_response
Description: Status output from the instant matching system mirroring website logic.

Name: registry_sync_completed
Description: Fires on background sync execution, verifying dynamic updates render without app-store release.

Name: sync_status
Description: Whether the local cache updated successfully.

Name: records_ingested
Description: The total number of contractor records updated during the sync.

Name: ratings_refresh_independent
Description: Boolean flag tracking if contractor ratings synced independently of the full registry schema.
